The deadline for submitting a written notice of termination to the current insurer to switch basic insurance at the end of the year varies depending on the country and the specific insurance regulations in place. Generally, it is important to check the policy documents or contact the insurance provider directly, as most jurisdictions require the notice to be received a certain number of days before the policy's renewal date—often within 30 days before the end of the policy period.

For example, in Switzerland, under the Krankenversicherungsgesetz (KVG), policyholders must send their notice of termination to the current insurer at least 3 months before the end of the policy year (typically by September 30th) to ensure a switch at year-end.

**Recommendation:**  
Always verify the exact deadline with your current insurer and check the terms outlined in your insurance policy, as rules can differ significantly by region and type of insurance.
